reviews.title: Doesn’t work - no support!
reviews.text: It just comes up with ‘please check your network and try again’! So you’ve taken my money but your app doesn’t work now - scammers!!!

reviews.title: Quality has gone down over the years
reviews.text: I remember getting this app years ago and it was absolutely spectacular, I used to use it to help customers clear up old blurry photos that they would bring in and it worked amazingly, but after the years of updates, I’ve noticed that it has just gotten worse and worse I used to be able to take a heavily blurred photo and make it almost crystal clear, and now a barely blurry Photo doesn’t change almost at all.

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: I uploaded a picture that was poor quality and the “updated” photo was the exact same picture.

reviews.title: It takes your money without you knowing
reviews.text: I bought this a few days ago and I deleted because I didn’t think I needed it and I got a notification that I spent 22.99 on a yearly subscription and i didn’t? So I’m just telling you they will take your money even if you have it deleted and the free trial too.

reviews.title: Terrible!!!
reviews.text: Did not do anything to enhance photo. The before and after looked exactly the same. Would not recommend, especially at 22.99/ month!
